contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ is [FL IVL] CONSTANS AVG GLORIA EXERCITVS TRS

A copper alloy nummus of Constans dating to the period AD 337 to 341 (Reece Period 17). Reverse type GLORIA EXERCITVS (1 standard). Cf LRBC I. 102; Trier mint. The diameter is 15mm. Reverse inscription is [FL IVL] CONSTANS AVG GLORIA EXERCITVS TRS
